titleText: 55 women murdered since 1970, 65% of cases involving partners
mainText: From Times of Malta: 55 women murdered since 1970, 65% of cases involving partners. Observatory renews plea for urgent action to prevent femicide

titleText: Femicides are preventable if treated with the required urgency – Malta Observatory on Femicide
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Femicides are preventable if treated with the required urgency – Malta Observatory on Femicide. The Malta Observatory on Femicide (MOF) has stated that, in its view, femicide is preventable, "if only it is treated with the urgency it requires."

titleText: Businessman acquitted of sexual assault after initially pleading guilty
mainText: From Times of Malta: Businessman acquitted of sexual assault after initially pleading guilty. The case had been sent back for a fresh hearing because the accused was not given the opportunity to reconsider his plea

titleText: Maltese performer graduates with distinction from London’s Mountview
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Maltese performer graduates with distinction from London’s Mountview. Maltese performer Hannah Spiteri has graduated with a Masters of Arts in Performance (Musical Theatre), with Distinction, from Mountview, one of London's leading drama schools.

titleText: Momentum urges public to object to seven-storey Mosta elderly care home
mainText: From MaltaToday: Momentum urges public to object to seven-storey Mosta elderly care home. Momentum has urged the public to submit formal objections to a proposed seven-storey elderly care home in Mosta before the 11 December deadline.
